# Iron: EOS reconstruction reports

<!-- Generated by scripts.generate_reconstruction_reports; edit EOSMAT instead. -->

[All reconstruction reports](index.md) · [Material and EOS parameters](../material-summaries/iron.md) · [EOSMAT record file](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/peritheos/data/materials/iron.eosmat) · [Audit sidecar](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/peritheos/data/audits/iron.audit.json)

Each section opens with the record's reproduction headline and any usage
warning ([label definitions](../eos-labels.md)), then the scope and basis of
the stored check. Only recorded content is shown: missing selections, weights,
errors or conventions are unknown, not zero, and are not inferred. Generating
this page fits nothing and changes no classification or source coefficient.
Every record is also listed by identifier in the
[numerical ledger](../primary-eos-refits.md#records), its
[machine-readable form](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/docs/data/primary-eos-refits.json) and the
[source-audit reports](../source-audits.md).

**Curves and residuals** replay the full stored source and reconstructed
coefficients on the same recorded audit inputs. Residual = model − input in
the fitted quantity's native units; for pressure, P(model) − P(input) at each
input volume and temperature (isothermal records use their reference
temperature). RMS is an unweighted descriptive error, not a parameter
uncertainty or the weighted fitting objective. With more than five
temperatures, the minimum, middle and maximum isotherms are drawn; residuals
include every selected row. Error bars appear only where all widths are
recoverable and keep the source meaning, including digitization widths.
No uncertainty band is inferred.

**Coefficient graphs** show stored central values and recorded error widths
in the audit's units; each panel includes zero. They are not observation or
residual plots. Fixed/adopted values are constraints, not recovered values.
Tables round an error to two significant digits when its leading digit is 1
or 2, otherwise one, and the value to the error's decimal place; values
without a positive error show at most six significant digits. Full precision
stays in EOSMAT and the ledger.

## Shen and Smith (2026), Cu-referenced Vinet

**reproduced** · `iron_shen_2026_vinet_2` · `Vinet` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/iron.md#record-iron_shen_2026_vinet_2)

**Scope:** Comparison with the source parameterization. **Basis:** Every compared free coefficient meets both the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison and parameter-specific numerical similarity screen. Error conventions and fit qualifications remain applicable.

- Direct reconstruction from source observations: each Table S1 phase volume is paired with its simultaneous Cu volume, pressure is evaluated from Fratanduono et al.'s analytic third-order 298 K Vinet fit, and K0 and K0\_prime are fitted with Shen and Smith's fixed V0 and stated run selection. The source publishes no pressure weights, residual covariance, or weighting protocol, so the reproduction uses unweighted pressure residuals and does not infer any of them.

### Method

- **Dataset identifiers:** shen\_smith\_2026\_table\_s1\_simultaneous\_volumes
- **Observations:** 380
- **Fit kind:** fixed\_v0\_vinet\_with\_reconstructed\_cu\_pressure
- **Selection:** hcp-Fe; DAC-1 and DAC-2
- **Objective:** unweighted\_pressure\_residuals
- **Absolute sigma:** False
- **Free parameters:** K0; K0\_prime
- **Fixed parameters:** V0

<a id="record-iron_dewaele_2019_mao_vinet"></a>

## Dewaele (2019), Fe MAO-scale Vinet

**reproduced** · `iron_dewaele_2019_mao_vinet` · `Vinet` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/iron.md#record-iron_dewaele_2019_mao_vinet)

**Scope:** Comparison with the source parameterization. **Basis:** Agreement within the source's reported parameter error widths; this is not an inferred confidence convention.

- Every compared free central value lies inside its printed source error width, with finite reconstructed standard errors under the explicit conditional error model. This is numerical parameter parity, not a formal source-confidence test or recovery of author workflow. Equal weights on the original pressure residuals; observed volumes and fixed coefficients conditioned on. Earlier audit statement (superseded only as to missing reconstruction uncertainty and the resulting numerical label): Complete source rows for this material are bundled and the dedicated two-ruby-scale refit recovers every coefficient within the published 95% interval. The common ledger classifies the result as similar, not strict parity, because the dedicated audit does not infer a refit covariance from rounded source rows. See docs/literature-reproductions/uncertainty-reconstruction.md for the complete conditional uncertainty budget.

### Method

- **Dataset identifiers:** iron\_dewaele\_2006\_epaps\_compression
- **Observations:** 53
- **Fit kind:** static\_vinet\_with\_explicit\_ruby\_scale\_conversion
- **Selection:** complete 53-row hcp selection; reported pressure is the source's ruby-linked effective pressure for both ruby and W-gauge rows
- **Objective:** unweighted pressure residuals
- **Weighting:** Equal weights on the original pressure residuals; observed volumes and fixed coefficients conditioned on.
- **Absolute sigma:** False
- **Free parameters:** V0; K0; K0\_prime
- **Fixed parameters:** None declared

**reproduced** · `iron_miozzi_2020_tange_2009_bm3_mgd_refit` · `BM3` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/iron.md#record-iron_miozzi_2020_tange_2009_bm3_mgd_refit)

**Scope:** Reproduction of a stored independent Peritheos refit. **Basis:** Reproduction of the registered Peritheos refit's stored coefficients under its declared protocol.

- This comparison concerns the stored independent Peritheos refit, not recovery of the original publication's coefficients or author workflow.
- Independent Peritheos equal-pressure-weight refit of all 131 Miozzi (2020) Fe observations; 116 pressures recalculated from paired MgO V,T using Tange (2009) Fit3-Vinet and 15 He pressures unchanged. This is not Miozzi's published EOS or a reproduction/correction of the original fit. V0,K0,K0\_prime,gamma0,q fitted jointly; theta0=420 K, Tr=300 K, n=1 and two Fe atoms/cell fixed. Errors/covariance are conditional local standard errors using RSS/(131-5), assuming independent equal-variance pressure residuals. Calibrant systematics, shared/run correlations, predictor errors, fixed-theta uncertainty and model discrepancy are not included. Measured coverage is a marginal envelope, not a rectangular stability domain or validation for core-condition extrapolation.
- Original publication reproduction status: not\_reproduced
